description: Decided in defk-dtw.10 (see its resolution for full rules) and defk-dtw.14. u64 scalar and [u64] element type; masked arithmetic: band(expr, 2^k-1) with a compile-time constant mask, + - * bsl band bor bxor bnot nest freely inside and compile to wrapping machine ops; bsr/div/rem only on in-range values; recognition is syntactic, with a compile-error hint to move arithmetic inside band; mixing i64 and u64 outside a mask is a compile error; u64 used as i64 is checked. Defk.Bits: clz/2, ctz/2, popcount/1, rotl/3, rotr/3, f64_to_u64/1 as plain Elixir functions mapped to builtins in kernels. Done when: tests in both modes cover mask boundaries (k=32, 63, 64), FNV-1a/murmur3 against known vectors, the compile-error hint, and Defk.Bits against their Elixir bodies; docs/language.md documents it.

comments.text: Implemented on branch defk-wlu/u64-masked-bits (80a2f73). Decisions beyond defk-dtw.10's text: (1) an i64 whose range facts prove it >= 0 (literal, len, [u8] element, narrow mask) promotes to u64 next to a u64, so h * 31 + 1 compiles; only an i64 that may be negative is u64-mix (new code, kind :subset, hint+rewrite = move inside band(..., 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)). (2) band(x, mask) now takes a leaf operand too (band(x, 0xFFFF...) is the i64->u64 conversion); the 64-bit mask yields u64, narrower masks i64 as before. (3) bsl by a non-literal count is in the wrapped tree: count >= 64 gives 0, a negative count raises ArithmeticError (limit: high bits would leak). This changes the old leaf_bsl test (band(bsl(1, 63) + 1, 255) now gives Elixir's 1 instead of raising). (4) mask constant expressions: + - * bsl of literals are folded for mask recognition only, so (1 <<< 63) - 1 is now a mask; shift-overflow's registry example changed to band(x, 1 <<< 63). (5) reduce: 0 with a u64 new value (or acc meeting a u64 in + - * band bor bxor div rem min max) retypes that accumulator as u64: the compiler re-lowers the fold from a saved process-dict state, Elixir mode settles types with a look-ahead (settle_accs). A literal-init acc meeting a u64 only through an if/cond branch is still branch-types. (6) Element writes: [u64] <- negative i64 and [i64] <- u64 > 2^63-1 raise ArgumentError 'value .. does not fit in ..' like [u8]; other u64<->i64 positions raise ArithmeticError. (7) Defk.Bits.clz/2, ctz/2, rotl/3, rotr/3 check width 1..64 and x in 0..2^w-1 (ArgumentError); rotl/rotr give x's type (i64 result checked). Old clz/1, ctz/1, popcount/1, rotl64/2, rotr64/2 kept; clz/ctz/popcount/1 accept u64. Kernels may call Defk.Bits.f(...) qualified.

Merged main (f116e70): [u64] folded into defk-4ai's element helpers (wide(:u64)=:u64, int_stored/2 for integer stores); u64_accs and with_acc_facts share lowering_key?/restore_lowering (now including {:defk_acc_facts,_}) so retries compose; runtime field-width helpers renamed defk_field_* to avoid defk-cmr's defk_bits_fail.

title: Add u64, masked arithmetic and Defk.Bits
